changeStrategyAsset(address).details: Single source of truth: the PoolKey is read from `FloatSwapRouterV4.getV4PoolConfig(asset)` (seeded         at deploy / extended via `setV4PoolConfig`). The frontend supplies only the asset address.         Flow:           1. Read `(key, _)` from `FloatSwapRouterV4.getV4PoolConfig(_newAssetAddr)`.           2. Validate the pulled key is canonical ASSET/WETH (`currency0 < currency1`, one side == WETH,              the other == `_newAssetAddr`). Catches a misregistered router entry before it reaches the              strategy.           3. Call `IFloatStrategyV4.changeAsset(asset, key)` — strategy flattens the OLD pool, swaps to              WETH, then adopts the NEW `key`. (Strategy reads `hookData` for LP ops directly from the              router by `address(ASSET)`, before AND after the rotation.)           4. Update the registry's `"ASSET"` entry and refresh the vault's local asset reference.

params._newAssetAddr: Non-WETH side of the pool — strategy's new ASSET. Must be pre-registered on the router.

exitStrategyToStable().details: `key` is unused by the strategy on the WETH exit path; pass an empty struct.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

changeStrategyAsset(address).notice: Rotate the v4 strategy's ASSET to one of the assets pre-registered with `FloatSwapRouterV4`.

exitStrategyToStable().notice: Flatten LP, swap to WETH, set strategy `STABLE` (mode 4). Registry `"ASSET"` becomes WETH.
